result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by requiring mutual written agreement for renewal and capping renewal fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. However, requiring all renewals to be successive 12-month periods is unnecessary under the mutual-agreement option and changes the original contemplated renewal duration more than needed. The clause also retains the defective phrase “mutual written of the parties,” leaves CPI undefined, and creates avoidable redundancy among subsections I–III. These issues reduce drafting quality but do not prevent compliance with the playbook.
